runners_data.name: Emily Love
runners_data.comment: One of five hurdle wins came here; rated 129 in that sphere; player if ready after break
runners_data.spotlight: 5-9 over hurdles and earned a handicap mark of 129; wouldn't have won but was running well when coming down two out on chase debut at Killarney; much respected.

runners_data.name: Future Prospect
runners_data.comment: Pulled-up at Cheltenham but better in a Fairyhouse Grade 1 since over 2m4f; this trip suit
runners_data.spotlight: Can race freely but she was smart in bumpers and wasn't beaten far in a Listed hurdle at Punchestown last time (2m, yielding); 1-1 in points and brings significant potential to chase career.

runners_data.name: Disco Dancer
runners_data.comment: Well beaten last time and needs to go beyond her best to win
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for the yard; bumper/dual winning hurdler; hasn't been at her best since returning from a year off and one or two others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Beauforts Storm
runners_data.comment: Reverts to hurdling after an unsuccessful spell over fences, likes good ground
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in three runs over fences before another heavy defeat back over hurdles; she was smart in 2024 but now has much to prove.

runners_data.name: Pampar Lady
runners_data.spotlight: Raised her game markedly last season over hurdles, winning three times to earn a mark of 118; trip/ground ideal for this first crack at chasing.

runners_data.name: Only A Dollar
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run at Limerick after a winter break, 1-18 record over hurdles is off-putting
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden over hurdles but not in the same league as her rivals in that discipline; limited appeal on chase debut.

runners_data.name: Killinure Lass
runners_data.comment: Dual-course winner inc' over C&D, likes it here but lacks a run and 4lb above last win
runners_data.spotlight: May have needed last month's run here after a break; runs this track well and won this 12 months ago off only 3lb lower; considered.

runners_data.name: Midnight Moonshine
runners_data.comment: Remains on a competitive mark but best form is over much further
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner who is 0-10 over fences; has placed form but he fell in March and his jumping lacked fluency at Wexford last time.

runners_data.name: Dinoland
runners_data.spotlight: Not the easiest to predict but he bounded clear over nearly 3m at Downpatrick 22 days ago to earn this 7lb higher mark; good ground is the key to him.

runners_data.name: Better Times
runners_data.comment: Downpatrick h'cap hurdle winner in March; unseated early lto; chase debut; not out of it
runners_data.spotlight: 5lb lower when winning a handicap hurdle in March; enjoys good ground and ran well for a long way on recent chase debut at Kilbeggan (2m3f, yielding); this trip likely suits him better and has possibilities in the new headgear.

runners_data.name: Aclass
runners_data.comment: Tramore beginners' winner, 3lb swing with Nettuno Italia for neck defeat latest, player
runners_data.spotlight: Won his beginners' chase here and ran right up to his best when beaten a neck over a tad shorter here last month; every chance off 3lb higher if in the same form.

runners_data.name: Ferdia
runners_data.comment: Has shown nothing in seven starts since returning from over three years off the track
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form in seven races (mostly chasing) since returning from a mammoth absence.

runners_data.name: Miss Lia
runners_data.comment: Good runs in defeat last season and again filled the second spot last time; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came in a maiden hurdle here in 2024; below par in her previous chase and it's been all or nothing in her last four races over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Major Barry
runners_data.comment: 2-7, ran well here on h'cap bow, won off 3lb lower at Cork, strip fitter for latest
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles in 2024 but lightly raced during the last 12 months and hasn't been anything like as good; potentially on a good mark for stable/chase debut but easy to have reservations.

runners_data.name: Jouster
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle/chase winner for Gavin Cromwell before losing his way; some signs of a revival when fourth at Downpatrick (2m3f) and he's slipped to a handy mark.

runners_data.name: Lake Chad
runners_data.comment: Poor run at Wexford last month, the balance of this season's form has been respectable
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who enhanced his excellent record here with an 11l success over this trip last month, when the return to drier ground made a big difference; raised 8lb but he's historically well handicapped still.

runners_data.name: Drop A Threat
runners_data.comment: Point winner but disappointing in seven starts; fourth on chase debut lto; needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Essentially disappointing given the impression he made in winning a point; beaten 17l and 46l in two chases, last time finishing behind Better Times; may do better in a handicap but not crying out to be backed.

runners_data.name: The Rebel County
runners_data.comment: Hunter chase winner has been soundly beaten over hurdles and fences lately; lots to find
runners_data.spotlight: Hunter chase winner 12 months ago but fairly slim pickings since then and cheekpieces now go on.

runners_data.name: Mount Shenshan
runners_data.comment: Hurdles winner, beaten off 92 in h'cap chase latest, best form on softer ground than this
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler; has the chase form to feature off this figure but he was well beaten in a beginners' chase here only yesterday.

runners_data.name: Mother Ship
runners_data.comment: Ran well over C&D last June, has gone well fresh, top rider booked, not dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to win any of her 16 races over hurdles but did have some placed form and she's bred to make a chaser.

runners_data.name: Menas Miracle
runners_data.spotlight: Two good runs in beginners' chases last October and could be all the sharper for her recent run over hurdles; this mark shouldn't be beyond her.

runners_data.name: Ballybrack Wood
runners_data.comment: Course winner in October 2024, missed all of 2025, could feature if fit and ready
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 2m4f beginners' chase here in 2024; lightly raced since and was tailed off here last month following a long stretch on the sidelines; hard to enthuse over after that and cheekpieces are now fitted.

runners_data.name: Revolut Ned
runners_data.spotlight: Third in a hunter chase here last year and returns to rules action after winning a point two weeks ago; however, others have more pressing claims when this is his handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Zolpharine
runners_data.comment: Easy chase win latest, 12lb lower over hurdles, in form and can't be discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Hit with a 10lb rise for winning comfortably at Limerick (2m6f, good), which was a belated first win over fences; encouraging that he followed up over hurdles here last night, admittedly off a lower mark than today's; he's in the zone.

runners_data.name: My Good Pal
runners_data.comment: Is 1-19 over hurdles; posted two decent chase runs incl' here; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: In first-time cheekpieces when a clear second over 2m7f at Downpatrick 22 days ago and the winner was Dinoland who contests the previous race; this 7yo gets in off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Cullenwaine
runners_data.comment: Runner-up to an easy winner at Tramore last time; contender from unchanged mark
runners_data.spotlight: Poor strike-rate and both wins were in 2024; however, chased home previous-race contender Lake Chad here before a near miss at Limerick last week; solid chance.

runners_data.name: The Border Boy
runners_data.comment: Won on good ground at Cork last summer, on a mark that gives him a fair chance
runners_data.spotlight: Only 1-21 over hurdles, the win coming on good ground at Wexford last summer (similar mark); did finish well held on chase debut in November and also in his subsequent run back hurdling.

runners_data.name: Patrick Street
runners_data.comment: Dual-purpose performer won here on the Flat last month; chase debut; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose gelding who won on the Flat last month; finished well for third over hurdles at Punchestown but over 2m and stamina could be an issue over this far on chase debut.

runners_data.name: Fr Gilligansvoyge
runners_data.comment: One win from 68 starts under rules when landing the 2023 Bishopscourt Cup at Punchestown
runners_data.spotlight: Rules record of 1-69 is a glaring negative but this veteran did run well to be fourth at Limerick nine days ago, finishing behind Cullenwaine.

runners_data.name: Barely Made It
runners_data.comment: Lightly-raced maiden was beaten a long way here last time; 9lb out of the h'cap
runners_data.spotlight: Well out of the weights last time so that's forgiven but was tailed off the run before; there's no substance to her chance.

runners_data.name: Princedici
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 and on the retreat when departing late on at Punchestown.

runners_data.name: Western Shores
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000euros foal; dam unraced sister to winners Outlander (high-class bumper and 2m-3m hurdle/chase), Now McGinty (smart 2m5f hurdle/2m7f chase) and Western Leader (smart bumper and 2m4f-2m5f hurdle/chase); needs checking in the betting.

runners_data.name: Quest With Copper
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; dam placed in 2m/2m2f hurdles, out of unraced half-sister to winners Mephisto (smart 1m4f-1m6f Flat and 2m2f-2m7f hurdle) and Almaydan (1m6f/1m7f Flat and useful 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase); one to watch.

runners_data.name: Drombane
runners_data.spotlight: Best form is the 11l second in a maiden at Clonmel (2m3f, soft), after which he dropped away tamely here over 2m4f on yielding; Townend rides the yard's other one.

runners_data.name: Secret Order
runners_data.comment: Reserve; weak form in points; triple-figure odds for both maidens, tailed off and UR
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form in points and triple-figure odds for his two maiden hurdles (tailed off and unseated midrace).

runners_data.name: Le Roi Du Livet
runners_data.spotlight: Easily his best RPR was when a well-held third behind Shuttle Diplomacy at Naas in January; solid enough run when second in a Cork novice but he's now 0-8 and could be vulnerable once more.

runners_data.name: Ripsnorter
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner for Andy Slattery last August but well beaten the following month on his hurdle/stable debut; has to concede weight to his principal rivals.

runners_data.name: Karma d'Airy
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for 250,000euros after finishing second in an Auteuil hurdle in 2024; given subsequent absence, presumably something was amiss when a remote third on stable debut in early 2025 (went off odds-on); interesting to gauge the level of confidence behind her.

runners_data.name: China Grill
runners_data.comment: Beaten 44l on hurdling debut at Tramore and can only be watched for now
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; tailed off in two maidens on good to yielding ground.

runners_data.name: Cocofred
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely bred and in top hands, but has yet to show much; remains best watched.

runners_data.name: Seven Towers
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two points and not far away in his last two bumpers at Kilbeggan and Sligo (both on goodish ground); good pedigree and destined to improve over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Alaskan View
runners_data.spotlight: Managed to win only one of her eight bumpers and has been off since October; one to watch.

runners_data.name: Teffian Warrior
runners_data.comment: Led before fading into fourth at Leopardstown, likely capable of better, cheekpieces now
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; 64-rated on the Flat after seven defeats; has ability but wouldn't be the obvious answer on hurdle debut with stamina to prove; the tongue-tie is new.

runners_data.name: Slowdownbarney
runners_data.spotlight: With Gavin Cromwell when tailed off in his previous hurdle race in 2024; plenty of competitive Flat form since then for John McConnell but not overly appealing on this return to jumping action.

runners_data.name: Victoria Kesia
runners_data.spotlight: 1m maiden winner for previous yard; nothing positive to report so far over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Woodie Campelltown
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a point but tailed off in a bumper and two maiden hurdles.

runners_data.name: Acheron
runners_data.comment: Unseated early on hurdling debut for this yard; poor on the level since; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Some sign of ability on the Flat at up to 1m4f; 80-1 when tailed off in a maiden at Clonmel where his jumping lacked any fluency.

runners_data.name: Hastily
runners_data.comment: Most recent win was over 6f at Cork last July, has rarely shown her best form at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Has no form in maiden hurdles and she's now a low-grade Flat performer; no appeal.

races.name: Get A Free Month Trial Of Racing TV Now Racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Miss Donna
runners_data.comment: Weakened over 2m1f at Wexford latest, this longer trip is a query; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Showed a glimmer when fourth behind Cousin Kate in a maiden hurdle here in October and again when a 9l fifth of 13 in a handicap hurdle at Wexford on latest; eased 1lb for that; place chance if backing it up.

runners_data.name: Liberated Light
runners_data.comment: Moderate recent form until almost made all in a change of tactics at Tramore last time
runners_data.spotlight: Back to form with 1.75l front-running second over C&D on penultimate off this mark; never travelled and didn't jump well when poor at Wexford last time; cheekpieces replace blinkers; could rebound back at this venue.

runners_data.name: Cool Summer
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on last year's Roscommon third, watch in first handicap; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; handicap debutante; fine 3l third in Roscommon maiden on hurdles debut last August; didn't build on it but the type to improve now switched to handicaps; could go well if gets a run.

runners_data.name: Liceo
runners_data.spotlight: French Flat winner; 0-7 over hurdles but showed a bit of promise when fourth at Galway last September (16.5f, good); 4lb lower here and may have needed latest; yard in form.

runners_data.name: Surviving Murmansk
runners_data.spotlight: Breakthrough win came over C&D last August off 4lb lower; below best on Flat and over hurdles in three starts since; off since poor AW effort in November; likely to need this run.

runners_data.name: Party Pack
runners_data.comment: Posted a couple of fair efforts over hurdles; tailed off at Down Royal; chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles; 5.5l second at Wexford last August off 2lb higher a standout effort; modest form both starts this year; others look more convincing.

runners_data.name: Rogue Sea
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner; no sign of winning potential in four maiden hurdles at 2m-2m1f but may improve for switch to a handicap; check market.

runners_data.name: Esticky End
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner is 0-13 over hurdles; didn't run terribly at Down Royal in December off this mark; should be sharper for latest run at Wexford when made late gains from the back; could outrun likely odds.

runners_data.name: Stormy Jenn
runners_data.comment: Flat winner, one of her best hurdling efforts when third at Navan on latest, place chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time Flat winner; 0-14 over hurdles; okay run at Navan in November (2m, heavy) but pulled up when last seen at Fairyhouse in December; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Las Brisas Boy
runners_data.comment: Moderate fourth on the first of two handicap runs, will need to improve, tongue-tie on now
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort to date over hurdles a 7.25l fifth of 19 at Punchestown (2m, gd-yld) in first-time tongue tie (retained); needs more to get his head in front.

runners_data.name: Avandra
runners_data.spotlight: 0-17 and yet to trouble the judge; beaten 26l in first-time blinkers at Wexford on latest; blinkers now added; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Blue Moon Boy
runners_data.spotlight: 2-7 on the Flat; left maiden hurdle form behind when a keeping on 2.25l second of 15 on handicap debut at Sligo (2m2f, good); raised 3lb; debatable whether this sharper test will suit but he's a player.

runners_data.name: Liss Eile
runners_data.comment: Some decent bumper runs; best hurdle run came at this track last year; has to repeat that
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; best maiden hurdle effort came over C&D but beaten 16.5l at Clonmel (2m, soft) and pulled up here (16.5f, gd-yld) on latest in first two handicaps; eased 3lb but others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Topothelane
runners_data.comment: Recent modest Tramore third (2m6f, yielding) mildly encouraging; back in trip here
runners_data.spotlight: 9yo built on mildly promising third here in April (20.5f, yielding) to win easily at Wexford (2m1f, gd-yld) three days ago; 7lb penalty for that but should go well again if in the same form.

runners_data.name: He Who Dares
runners_data.spotlight: Ordinary form so far on the Flat and in four runs over hurdles; hood now reached for; lacks a recent run; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Theanniversary Man
runners_data.comment: Came good at Thurles last month on second run for this yard, further progress is likely
runners_data.spotlight: Has found form for this yard, notching up successive wins at Thurles (2m, gd-yld) and Cork (2m4f, sft-hvy) in November/December; has gone up a cumulative 14lb and has been off 174 days but can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Bangor Lady
runners_data.comment: Was running well in Clonmel maiden when coming down two out; not ruled out on handicap bow
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to make an impact in four maiden hurdles; no sign of improvement on handicap debut at Sligo (held by Blue Moon Boy on that effort).

races.name: Group Packages And Discounts At Tramoreraces.ie Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Tolka Row
runners_data.comment: Ran respectably on hurdling debut when eighth of 17 at Clonmel (19.5f) eight days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two of three point-to-point starts; midfield in 2m3f maiden hurdles at Clonmel and Downpatrick (both gd-yld); will qualify for a handicap mark after this.

runners_data.name: Sharu
runners_data.comment: Should improve from a bumper run, stable has a strong candidate here in Kilgame
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in a Down Royal bumper in December (2m, yielding) and a 2m Punchestown maiden hurdle (heavy) in January; off since and hopes pinned on good ground sparking some improvement.

runners_data.name: Fabhcun
runners_data.comment: Best of three m'den hurdle runs came on debut on hvy; chance of repeating that on better
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 100; best effort over hurdles a 7l fifth of 7 on debut at Gowran (2m, heavy); beaten 12l at Kilbeggan on latest (15.5f, gd-yld), staying on late; looks sure to improve for this longer trip; cheekpieces go on.

runners_data.name: Thiscouldbetheone
runners_data.comment: Held by runner-up Newbrook Diamond on the evidence of a Naas run
runners_data.spotlight: Promise on debut in Listed Limerick bumper (2m, soft); stayed on for a 25l sixth of 25 in much stronger maiden than this at Naas (2m, yielding) in January; very disappointing at Fairyhouse latest, however; cheekpieces and tongue tie go on for first start on good ground (brother City Island won three times on good ground).

runners_data.name: Headcorn
runners_data.comment: Capable pointer but was tailed off in his previous hunter chase when sent off 200-1
runners_data.spotlight: 2-15 in point-to-points; well beaten both starts under Rules in hunter chases at Limerick and Killarney; best watched on belated hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Rattledelatch
runners_data.comment: 50-1 and pulled up on debut in a Gowran maiden hurdle, seems safe to rule out
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on hurdles debut at Gowran in November; tailed off in a bumper at Punchestown latest; cheekpieces tried now.

runners_data.name: The Ducks Walk
runners_data.comment: Point winner, completely tailed off on hurdling debut at Punchestown, can be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; huge odds for both starts over hurdles and ran accordingly; may do better when tackling handicaps.

runners_data.name: Nells Princess
runners_data.comment: Point winner shaped well in first bumper but poor effort over 2m3f since; hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; promise in Punchestown bumper on Rules' debut; weakened after two out when upped to 22.5f on hurdles debut at Killarney on latest; more needed to take this.

runners_data.name: Akako
runners_data.comment: Not much sign of promise in a point and maiden hurdle so makes no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: First sign of ability on debut for this yard when keeping on for a never nearer 14l seventh of 17 at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld); this longer trip should suit.

runners_data.name: Butch Coolidge
runners_data.comment: Nice pedigree and has shown small hints of ability in maidens; hood goes on now; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: From a good family but has yet to show winning potential in three runs over hurdles and rated 93; new hood needs to transform.

runners_data.name: Lady Cosmo
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two maiden hurdles and can only be watched for the time being; cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner has been tailed off in both starts in maiden hurdles; best watched on first start for new yard.

runners_data.name: Installment
runners_data.spotlight: Very modest form so far in two bumpers and when tailed off in a Sligo maiden hurdle when last sighted 321 days ago; seems safe to rule out.

runners_data.name: Believe That
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran; 0-32 in point-to-points; 0-5 over hurdles and rated 92 but those five runs came back in 2021; not easy to fancy.

runners_data.name: Majestic Mayhem
runners_data.comment: Tailed off on bumper debut here last month; tremendous improvement required
runners_data.spotlight: Heavy defeats in a bumper and maiden hurdle, both at Kilbeggan; others appeal more.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (Mares) INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Gortnaclea Castle
runners_data.comment: Fine debut run but might not have stayed 2m4f last time; has to resume progress
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two of her three bumpers, last time beating all bar a De Bromhead-trained favourite at Wexford (good to yielding); sets the standard.

runners_data.name: Arivabodiva
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Looksnowtlikebrian (useful 2m3f-3m2f hurdle/chase), Rivabodiva (2m7f/3m hurdle) and Divaboriva (bumper); dam 2m3f-3m hurdle/chase winner; immediate fitting of a hood is concerning but her yard has won the last two renewals of this bumper.

runners_data.name: Cotswold Blue
runners_data.comment: Authorized mare, dam half-sister to Big Buck's, top yard, of obvious interest on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 68,000euros yearling by Authorized; half-sister to winners Rickety Bridge (point/2m4f hurdle) and Raffles Capital (French 2m1f hurdle/2m2f chase); dam a half-sister to multiple Stayers' Hurdle winner Big Buck's; top yard and of obvious interest on debut, despite the immediate fitting of a hood.

runners_data.name: Lavender Lady
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unplaced in bumper/2m4f hurdle, out of 2m2f hurdle winning half-sister to high-class bumper and 1m7f-3m hurdle/chase winner Otago Trail; hooded for debut.

runners_data.name: Bluebell Breeze
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unplaced over hurdles/in points, half-sister to winners Crebilly (useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and Lady Of The Sea (2m4f/3m hurdle); likely one for further down the line.

runners_data.name: Gunner Girl
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to point winner All Night Parking; dam 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner; another newcomer in this race to be fitted with a hood from the outset.

runners_data.name: C'Est Elle
runners_data.comment: Third on bumper debut at Thurles (hvy); a leading player once handling this faster surface
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in a point; beaten 9l and 15l in her two bumpers, latterly finishing behind Gortnaclea Castle; has to step up.

runners_data.name: Isabella Johnson
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 in bumpers but it was a good run four days ago at Ballinrobe when third behind a promising winner (2m, good); each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Riverwoods
runners_data.comment: Much better effort in Wexford maiden hurdle latest, go well if handling softer conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Her standout run is the second in a Wexford maiden hurdle last August; well held either side of that, so difficult to know what to expect.

runners_data.name: Ronnie Returns
runners_data.comment: 66-1 and tailed off on debut at Gowran, huge step forward needed here
runners_data.spotlight: Completely tailed off in bumpers on heavy and soft ground; different conditions here if nothing else.
